title: Launch Metrics & Execution Under Pressure
description: Practice making high-stakes launch decisions using real-world metrics, tradeoffs, and shifting market conditions.

interactions.prompt: Your SaaS product beta has 2,000 users. DAU is 34%, NPS is 62, but Week 4 retention dropped from 41% to 19%. Feature requests are surging. What's the key signal?

options.text: NPS of 62 confirms strong product-market fit for launch
Retention cliff at Week 4 signals a critical engagement gap
Rising feature requests show enthusiastic power users
34% DAU is healthy enough to proceed with launch

interactions.prompt: You're launching a fintech payments product. A major competitor just announced a similar feature shipping in 6 weeks. Your product is 85% ready with incomplete fraud detection. Launch now or wait?

options.text: Launch now with manual fraud review to capture market first
Wait 6 weeks to ship complete fraud detection
Soft launch to limited geographies where fraud risk is lowest
Launch fully but cap transaction limits until fraud detection ships

interactions.prompt: In launch playbook design, the 'T-minus' countdown should define clear ____ for each milestone so cross-functional teams can identify blockers before they cascade.

options.text: Go/no-go criteria
Revenue targets
Executive approvals
Marketing assets

interactions.prompt: You're 3 weeks from launching an enterprise AI tool. Rank these actions by impact on launch success, highest first: (a) Finalize pricing tiers, (b) Train sales team on objection handling, (c) Secure 3 customer case studies, (d) Stress-test infrastructure at 10x expected load.

options.text: Finalize pricing tiers
Train sales team on objection handling
Secure 3 customer case studies
Stress-test infrastructure at 10x expected load

interactions.prompt: Post-launch Week 1 dashboard for a Shopify app: 8,400 installs, 62% activation rate, 4.1-star rating (210 reviews), but paid conversion is 1.2% vs. 4% target. Support tickets averaging 14-minute resolution. What matters most?

options.text: 4.1-star rating with 210 reviews shows solid market reception
Paid conversion at 1.2% vs. 4% target signals broken monetization funnel
62% activation rate is strong for a new product launch
8,400 installs in Week 1 exceeds typical Shopify benchmarks

chartData.title: Key Metrics vs Targets - Week 1 Performance

interactions.prompt: Stripe is launching a new product in Southeast Asia. Your beta cohort in Singapore (200 merchants) shows strong results, but Indonesia (800 merchants) has mixed feedback with 38% citing localization issues. Full regional launch is in 4 weeks.

options.text: Launch across all SEA markets on schedule to hit quarterly targets
Launch Singapore only, delay Indonesia 8 weeks for localization fixes
Launch both but gate Indonesia to top-tier merchants with dedicated support
Delay entire regional launch until Indonesia localization is resolved

interactions.prompt: It's now Week 2. A viral TikTok video showcasing your gated Indonesia launch hit 2.3M views. Inbound merchant sign-up requests jumped 12x overnight. Your support team is sized for the original gated plan. What do you do?

options.text: Open the gate fully and hire emergency contract support
Create a waitlist with priority tiers based on merchant volume
Keep the gate unchanged and let organic demand build anticipation
Redirect all inbound to Singapore launch while scaling Indonesia ops

interactions.priorContext: Previously you chose a gated Indonesia launch with top-tier merchants and dedicated support. Now unexpected viral demand is overwhelming your planned capacity.

interactions.prompt: Your launch playbook post-mortem reveals 4 failures. Rank by severity for future launches, most critical first: (a) Sales enablement materials delivered 2 days post-launch, (b) No pre-defined rollback criteria when activation dropped below 30%, (c) PR embargo broken 48 hours early by a partner, (d) Pricing page A/B test wasn't live until Day 3.

options.text: Sales enablement materials delivered 2 days late
No pre-defined rollback criteria for low activation
PR embargo broken 48 hours early by partner
Pricing page A/B test delayed until Day 3
